claims.criteria: The copy limits the comparison to visible road marks and outfit colour contrast. It does not claim that a light wash is inherently warmer, slower-drying or less durable than dark denim.
claims.statement: Pale denim shows road splashes sooner than a dark wash, while deeper top colours create clear visual contrast against light blue jeans.

claims.criteria: Fit guidance is framed as a movement and hem-length test rather than a universal comfort guarantee. Readers are told to choose based on their own waistband, thigh, knee and route conditions.
claims.statement: Regular, straight, slim and relaxed fits can all work in the monsoon when the pair leaves usable room to move and the hem clears wet ground.

claims.criteria: The garment label is stated as authoritative. General care advice is limited to source-backed steps and makes no drying-time, odour-prevention or fabric-performance guarantee.
claims.statement: When the care label permits machine washing, turn jeans inside out, use cold water and mild detergent, wash with similar colours, then dry fully in a shaded, ventilated space.

claims.criteria: The customer-facing copy does not name, count or describe current SKUs because the live cards contain conflicting fit/model labels and assortment can change. It only links to the current collection pages and tells readers to use live product details as the final reference.
claims.statement: Spykar maintains dedicated light-blue-jeans collection pages for men and women; current fit, rise and availability should be confirmed on those live pages.

claims.criteria: Keyword volumes supplied by the user guide editorial emphasis only and do not appear in customer-facing copy.
claims.statement: The assigned title and keyword set establish light blue jeans as the primary topic with separate men, women and monsoon-outfit variations.

claims.criteria: The article makes no unqualified best, top, leading or performance-superiority claim. Recommendations are conditional on fit, route, hem length, colour contrast and care-label instructions.
claims.statement: The article provides practical outfit formulas without presenting any product, fit or brand as universally superior.
